description: 016, FR-017: a tasks.md whose task lines carry real markup — backtick paths, bold, italic, strikethrough, a link, an unbalanced delimiter, a backslash escape, a non-http target and non-ASCII text — mirrors sub-tasks whose descriptions render that markup as native formatting rather than literal punctuation, byte-identically across both ports. The bridge-composed metadata bullets stay plain text (FR-018).
name: us1-task-markdown-rendering
